description: A huge winged bull statue with a bearded human head in a horned crown stands beside a robed, bearded king on a red-stepped dais, with a fan-bearer and attendants. Rows of long tables are laden with bread and jars, and servants carry platters through a courtyard lit by braziers and torches. Brick walls with relief carvings frame the left side, with smoke rising in a dark sky. No visible text, frame or border.
